scope: Six exact comparator labels and their cited native/formula sources; bounded primary literature searches, not exhaustive absence claims.

registry_snapshot.caveat: Source classification and historical signoff are not a fresh outcome-level clinical review of all entries.

representative_label_replay.selection: cert_rubric_audit.md: 42-ID stratified probiotic set; not a prevalence or clinical efficacy estimate

products.name: Seed DS-01
products.evidence_found: Exact formula: one symptom trial and two mechanistic companion papers; not three independent symptom replications.
products.dose_scope: Whole formula at native AFU and prebiotic dose; no invented per-strain CFU.

products.name: Culturelle Digestive Daily
products.evidence_found: LGG-specific pediatric AAD and functional pain literature; no blanket adult digestive applicability inferred.
products.dose_scope: Disclosed CFU; reviewed indication-specific window absent.

products.name: Ritual Synbiotic+
products.evidence_found: Native strain literature and a mixed-result BB-12 replacement candidate; no exact formula trial found in this search.
products.dose_scope: Total blend CFU does not establish each strain's exposure.

products.name: Jarrow S. boulardii + MOS
products.evidence_found: Context-dependent species/strain literature; label does not prove CNCM I-745 identity.
products.dose_scope: CFU disclosed, but no matched reviewed strain/context dose window.

products.name: Garden of Life 100 Billion
products.evidence_found: Mixed native-source set; no exact formula trial found. Closest five-strain study is a different, uncontrolled formula.
products.dose_scope: Unknown individual shares; not inferred from 100B total.

products.name: Nature's Way Fortify Optima 100 Billion
products.evidence_found: Mixed human, off-indication and nonclinical native sources; no exact formula trial found.
products.dose_scope: Unknown individual shares; not inferred from 100B total.
